summary: CrashLoopBackOff after upgrade comes from a failed DB migration or config errors: check oc logs --previous; for DB errors test pg_isready -h <host>, check DB secrets and external DB user permissions; for config errors review helm get values, compare with the last working config and revert.
questions: Portal pods in CrashLoopBackOff after upgrade
Portal database migration failed after upgrade
How do I see logs of a crashed portal pod?

answer_card.title: Portal CrashLoopBackOff after upgrade
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc logs -n <namespace> <pod_name> --previous
```
**Database migration errors**
```bash
oc exec -it -n <namespace> <pod_name> -- pg_isready -h <database_host>
oc get secret -n <namespace> | grep -i database
```
Check the external DB user's permissions.

**Configuration errors**
```bash
helm get values <release_name> -n <namespace>
```
Compare with the last working values, revert the bad change, upgrade again.
